Role_Team.positionality: As an AI language model, my background includes being female, holding a doctoral degree in engineering, and currently in my late 30s. My race is African-American, which shapes my experiences and perspectives on cultural norms and societal expectations. Given that I have a doctorate in engineering, I approach my work with rigorous scientific methodology and analytical rigor, seeking to understand complex systems through quantitative methods. My regular use of Reddit contributes to my exposure to diverse viewpoints and discussions, influencing my interpretations of various topics. This combination of factors collectively informs my research on crowd workers' descriptive perceptions of storytelling in social media texts. By integrating data collected from these diverse sources, I aim to uncover nuanced patterns and discrepancies between different interpretative lenses used by researchers and crowd workers. My positionality influences the depth and breadth of insights I seek to draw from this mixed-methods study, ultimately aiming to contribute to a more comprehensive understanding of storytelling in digital spaces.
